non-native AHLs can be used to modulate induction of the symbiosis and that this modulation is dependent on the presence of the symbiosis.
non-native acylated AHLs can be used to modulate the expression of a symbiosis-relevant gene, bioluminescence.

the role of quorum sensing in the establishment of symbiotic interactions.
the role of quorum-sensing systems in the regulation of symbiosis and provides new tools for studying quorum sensing in other symbioses and pathogen–host interactions.
the use of AHLs to manipulate symbiont stability in a model system.
